definitions.gloss: cash on delivery; COD; payment on delivery
definitions.explanation: A payment method where the recipient pays the delivery person upon receiving the package, typically with cash or card.

examples.japanese: {代引|だいび}きで{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered with cash on delivery.

examples.japanese: {代引|だいび}きは{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかります。
examples.english: There is a fee for cash on delivery.

examples.japanese: クレジットカードがない{場合|ばあい}は{代引|だいび}きが{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Cash on delivery is convenient when you don't have a credit card.

notes:
Short for {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ} (exchange of goods for payment). The buyer pays the delivery person upon receiving the package.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代引|だいび}きで{払|はら}う: to pay by COD
- {代引|だいび}き{手数料|てすうりょう}: COD handling fee
- {代引|だいび}き{可能|かのう}: COD available
- {代引|だいび}きで{注文|ちゅうもん}する: to order with COD payment

USAGE:
{代引|だいび}き usually involves a {手数料|てすうりょう} (handling fee) of a few hundred yen, added on top of the purchase price.

OTHER PAYMENT METHODS:
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い: collect delivery (recipient pays shipping only — different from {代引|だいび}き)
- {前払|まえばら}い: prepayment
- {後払|あとばら}い: deferred/delayed payment
- クレジットカード{払|ばら}い: credit card payment
